passages.text: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it, you are to take some of the firstfruits of all your produce from the soil of the land that the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name, to the priest who is serving at that time, and say to him, “I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God gives you a land as an inheritance.
You enter this land.
You take possession of the land.
You settle in the land.
You gather the firstfruits from all your produce.
This produce comes from the soil of the land the LORD your God gives you.
You put the firstfruits in a basket.
You go to the place the LORD your God will choose for His Name to dwell.
You find the priest who serves at that time.
You say to the priest, “I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered the land.”
The LORD swore to our fathers to give us this land.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־ תָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֖הּ וְיָשַׁ֥בְתָּ בָּֽהּ׃ וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מֵרֵאשִׁ֣ית׀ כָּל־ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תָּבִ֧יא מֵֽאַרְצְךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָ֖ךְ וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ בַטֶּ֑נֶא וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אֶל־ הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֗יו הִגַּ֤דְתִּי הַיּוֹם֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּי־ בָ֙אתִי֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ לָ֥תֶת לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God, and you are to declare before the LORD your God, “My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt few in number and lived there and became a great nation, mighty and numerous.
passages.sermon:
The priest will take the basket from your hands.
The priest will place the basket before the altar of the LORD your God.
You will speak before the LORD your God.
You will say, “My father was a wandering Aramean.
He went down to Egypt.
He was few in number.
He lived in Egypt.
He became a great nation there.
He became mighty and numerous.”
passages.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַטֶּ֖נֶא מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ וְהִ֨נִּיח֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֕י מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ וְעָנִ֨יתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲרַמִּי֙ אֹבֵ֣ד אָבִ֔י וַיֵּ֣רֶד מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וַיָּ֥גָר שָׁ֖ם בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֑ט וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֕ם לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל עָצ֥וּם וָרָֽב׃

passages.text: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us, putting us to hard labor.
passages.sermon: The Egyptians treated us badly.\r\nThey caused us to suffer.\r\nThey forced us to do hard labor.
passages.original: וַיָּרֵ֧עוּ אֹתָ֛נוּ הַמִּצְרִ֖ים וַיְעַנּ֑וּנוּ וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עֲבֹדָ֥ה קָשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: So we called out to the LORD, the God of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites suffered in Egypt.
The Egyptians oppressed the Israelites.
The Israelites cried out to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of our fathers.
The LORD heard our voice.
The LORD saw our suffering.
The LORD saw our hard labor.
The LORD saw our oppression.
passages.original: וַנִּצְעַ֕ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ קֹלֵ֔נוּ וַיַּ֧רְא אֶת־ עָנְיֵ֛נוּ וְאֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֖נוּ וְאֶת־ לַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror, signs, and wonders.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of our fathers.
The LORD brought us out of Egypt.
He used a mighty hand.
He used an outstretched arm.
He showed great terror.
He performed signs.
He performed wonders.
passages.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נוּ יְהוָה֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם בְּיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמֹרָ֖א גָּדֹ֑ל וּבְאֹת֖וֹת וּבְמֹפְתִֽים׃

passages.text: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of our fathers.
The LORD brought us to this place.
The LORD gave us this land.
This land flows with milk and honey.
passages.original: וַיְבִאֵ֖נוּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD, have given me.” Then you are to place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD gave me this land.
Now I have brought the firstfruits of the land.
These are the first crops from the ground.
I place them before the LORD my God.
I bow down before the LORD my God.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֤ה הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ רֵאשִׁית֙ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִנַּחְתּ֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔יתָ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: So you shall rejoice—you, the Levite, and the foreigner dwelling among you—in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God gives you good things.
He gives good things to your household.
You must rejoice in these good things.
The Levite must rejoice with you.
The foreigner living among you must rejoice with you.
You, the Levite, and the foreigner all share in the good things God gives.
You must all be glad together.
passages.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֣ בְכָל־ הַטּ֗וֹב אֲשֶׁ֧ר נָֽתַן־ לְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּלְבֵיתֶ֑ךָ אַתָּה֙ וְהַלֵּוִ֔י וְהַגֵּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: When you have finished laying aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you are to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat and be filled within your gates.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command about tithes.
Every third year is called the year of the tithe.
In that year, you must set aside a tenth of all your produce.
You must give this tithe to the Levite.
You must also give it to the foreigner.
You must give it to the fatherless.
You must give it to the widow.
These people will eat within your towns.
They will have enough and be satisfied.
passages.original: כִּ֣י תְכַלֶּ֞ה לַ֠עְשֵׂר אֶת־ כָּל־ מַעְשַׂ֧ר תְּבוּאָתְךָ֛ בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ת שְׁנַ֣ת הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֑ר וְנָתַתָּ֣ה לַלֵּוִ֗י לַגֵּר֙ לַיָּת֣וֹם וְלָֽאַלְמָנָ֔ה וְאָכְל֥וּ בִשְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ וְשָׂבֵֽעוּ׃

passages.text: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God, “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me. I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments.
passages.sermon:
You must speak before the LORD your God.
You must say, “I have removed the sacred portion from my house.
I have given the sacred portion to the Levite.
I have given it to the foreigner.
I have given it to the fatherless.
I have given it to the widow.
I have done this as You commanded me.
I have not disobeyed Your commandments.
I have not forgotten Your commandments.”
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לִפְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בִּעַ֧רְתִּי הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ מִן־ הַבַּ֗יִת וְגַ֨ם נְתַתִּ֤יו לַלֵּוִי֙ וְלַגֵּר֙ לַיָּת֣וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֔ה כְּכָל־ מִצְוָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתָ֑נִי לֹֽא־ עָבַ֥רְתִּי מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while in mourning, or removed any of it while unclean, or offered any of it for the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything You commanded me.
passages.sermon:
I did not eat any of the sacred portion while I was in mourning.
I did not remove any of it while I was unclean.
I did not give any of it for the dead.
I listened to the voice of the LORD my God.
I did everything the LORD commanded me.
passages.original: לֹא־ אָכַ֨לְתִּי בְאֹנִ֜י מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹא־ בִעַ֤רְתִּי מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ בְּטָמֵ֔א וְלֹא־ נָתַ֥תִּי מִמֶּ֖נּוּ לְמֵ֑ת שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י עָשִׂ֕יתִי כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתָֽנִי׃

passages.text: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.”
passages.sermon:
God lives in heaven.
He dwells in a holy place.
God, look down from Your holy dwelling in heaven.
Bless Your people.
Your people are Israel.
Bless the land You have given us.
You promised this land to our fathers.
This land flows with milk and honey.
passages.original: הַשְׁקִיפָה֩ מִמְּע֨וֹן קָדְשְׁךָ֜ מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶֽת־ עַמְּךָ֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֵת֙ הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לָ֑נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתָּ֙ לַאֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
Today, He gives you a command.
He commands you to obey these statutes.
He commands you to obey these ordinances.
You must keep them.
You must do them.
You must obey with all your heart.
You must obey with all your soul.
passages.original: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מְצַוְּךָ֧ לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֤ וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: Today you have proclaimed that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in His ways, keep His statutes and commandments and ordinances, and listen to His voice.
passages.sermon:
Today you have made a proclamation.
You have said that the LORD is your God.
You will walk in the ways of the LORD.
You will keep the statutes of the LORD.
You will keep the commandments of the LORD.
You will keep the ordinances of the LORD.
You will listen to the voice of the LORD.
passages.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה הֶאֱמַ֖רְתָּ הַיּ֑וֹם לִהְיוֹת֩ לְךָ֨ לֵֽאלֹהִ֜ים וְלָלֶ֣כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֗יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר חֻקָּ֧יו וּמִצְוֺתָ֛יו וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And today the LORD has proclaimed that you are His people and treasured possession as He promised, that you are to keep all His commandments, that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
Today, the LORD has declared something about you.
He has chosen you to be His people.
You are His treasured possession.
He promised this to you.
You must keep all His commandments.
The LORD will set you above all the nations He has made.
He will give you praise.
He will give you a great name.
He will give you honor.
You will be a holy people to the LORD your God.
The LORD promised this.
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה הֶאֱמִֽירְךָ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לָ֑ךְ וְלִשְׁמֹ֖ר כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָֽיו׃ וּֽלְתִתְּךָ֣ עֶלְי֗וֹן עַ֤ל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לִתְהִלָּ֖ה וּלְשֵׁ֣ם וּלְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְלִֽהְיֹתְךָ֧ עַם־ קָדֹ֛שׁ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
